Light: Your combat vehicles and spies are forfeit +1 here.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-2022-06-01-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifbeach.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifbeach.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: Krennic and death troopers are power +1 here. '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (the side credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed; on some cards icons or the set-icon position also changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Scarif: Beach (Dark) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 11 June 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-2022-06-11-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifbeach.gif</code> as published 11 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifbeach.gif holotable commit 6894629] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: Krennic and death troopers are power +1 here. Light: Your combat vehicles and spies are forfeit +1 here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF at a larger size (745×534 → 1039×745 pixels) with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, which re-made 51 landscape card images that day; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name); it is the same card enlarged, with the same rounded transparent corners — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged. A visible (resolution) change, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
